name: COWCAW! Watashi no Hanawa no Tatsuna o Hiite!
original_name: COWCAW!私の鼻輪の手綱を引いて!
source:
"I threw away the mask of an honor student to fulfill my wish to become a female slave."
"As the days of training continue, I become more and more distant from humanity."

An SM-themed AVG from the perspective of a masochistic woman. Midori, an honor student who excelled in her grades and served as student council vice president, had one ambition. She wanted to go to a university outside of her prefecture, unleash her "perversion" that she had never shown to anyone before, find a master, and be trained! Where will she end up after dressing up in a cow-patterned catsuit...? "I'm giving up my human identity and becoming a cow." This phrase has struck all of you perverted masochistic gentlemen. Please enjoy.
